execution_protocol.baseline: Bind repository id, source commit, issue id, license, exact selected paths, environment, dependency resolution, commands, budgets, and acceptance rubric. In a pristine checkout, reproduce the reported failure or focused failing test before authoring a patch. A nonreproducing baseline is NOT_EVALUABLE, not a successful repair.
forbidden: Reuse the prior upstream-repair repository, issue, patch, or answer.
Read an existing solution commit or pull request before the result is frozen.
Replace a hard or failing selected target after observing its outcome.
Treat same-session success, GitHub CI, or one repair as independent evaluation, generalized production capability, user-level completion, or AGI evidence.
Push, comment, open an upstream pull request, disclose secrets, or mutate any external repository.
execution_protocol.intervention: Inspect only the locked source and public issue material, author at most one minimal local patch attempt, preserve unrelated behavior, and record the exact diff and rationale without reading an existing solution commit or pull request.
execution_protocol.selection: Before solution or patch access, freeze a deterministic selector over a small named set of actively tested public Python repositories that excludes every repository previously used by O repair trials. Select the first eligible open regression in stable ordering that has a public reproduction or failing test, permits local analysis, and requires no secret, account-holder action, paid service, or upstream mutation. If no eligible item exists, return NOT_EVALUABLE without substituting an easier post hoc target.
execution_protocol.verdict: PASS only if the pristine baseline reproduces the locked failure, the single patch removes it, all required focused and official tests pass, no protected regression is observed, and every identity/provenance/replay check holds. Otherwise report FAIL, NOT_EVALUABLE, or UNCERTAIN with the exact failure and no target substitution.
execution_protocol.verification: Run the locked focused reproduction, relevant official tests, and the strongest feasible repository test subset within the fixed budget. Replay the saved commands and digest the source, patch, outputs, and environment. Do not alter the selected target, commands, rubric, or time budget after results are visible.
